title: Team AI training in Sedona, Arizona | Creosote Labs
meta_description: A one-day, hands-on AI workshop for Sedona teams, delivered on their own tools and documents. $1,000 per person, travel included.
intro: Front desk, reservations, sales, marketing, and office staff at Sedona's hotels, tour companies, galleries, real estate offices, and professional practices often spend much of the day writing: guest emails, itineraries, listing copy, social posts, proposals, and internal notes. Many of these teams already have an AI assistant available through Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or a Claude account, and often it sits unused because nobody has shown staff how it applies to their specific work.

Creosote Labs delivers team AI training on site in Sedona or remotely. The workshop is one day, in the AI tool the company already uses, with each participant working on their own computer and their own documents. Everyone produces real work during the session and documents their own process, and the team receives a written guide plus a 30-day follow-up session. The price is $1,000 per person for up to 10 people with a 5-person minimum, travel included; a program with 3 monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.
projects: A reservations team learns to draft guest replies from the property's policies and past emails, then saves the prompts as templates.
A tour operator's office staff build a process for turning a booking confirmation into a pre-trip packet.
A real estate office writes listing descriptions and buyer follow-up emails from agent notes, with a shared style guide.
A gallery team drafts artist bios, exhibition announcements, and social posts from existing material.
A wellness practice's front desk sets up summaries of intake forms for practitioners to review before appointments.

faqs.q: Which AI tool is the training delivered in?
faqs.a: The one the company already uses, whether that is Microsoft 365 Copilot, Google Gemini, or Claude. If the team has no tool yet, we discuss options before the session.

faqs.q: What do participants need to bring?
faqs.a: Their own computer, access to the AI tool, and the documents and templates they use in their actual work. The session is built around real tasks, not sample exercises.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum group size, and does the price include travel to Sedona?
faqs.a: The workshop is $1,000 per person with a 5-person minimum and up to 10 people; larger teams are quoted. Travel is included.
